notes.title: HP Patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
we balanced the HP loss during the power up, now the game hopefully is much more playable than before.

notes.title: New trailer, screenshots and release date
notes.notes:
Hi guys, trailer and screenshots have been updated, i hope you enjoy. I also found a publisher (Valkyrie Initiative) that will help in the release of the game, we are discussing about the release date that should be in the first quarter of 2020, stay tuned for the official release date.

notes.title: Development Update - Localization (Spanish, French, Italian, German)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, this is a little update to tell you that all the texts in the game will be localized in Spanish, French, Italian and German, also the Steam page. If you would like to have also other languages please comment below to let me know, so i can see if i can add more languages. The next update will follow soon, probably with a new trailer.  
This is a new promo art, you can find it also in the artwork section

notes.title: Development Update - Characters, animations, levels and more
notes.notes:
Hi guys ːsteamhappyː, first update for Hippocampus since the opening of the Steam page. I'm happy to announce that the development is going fast and smoothly, in these two months the work has been focused on adding new enemy characters as well as a lot of new animations, including a new boss fight. https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34997588/4140cd5647399de786b14023e3f3301ef8b1087a.png
The game now has almost all the sound effects needed and a new hud design
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34997588/b808407b5e16fd44824ee3debb55b59967adc5d6.jpg
The game difficulty has been balanced according to players' feedback after some playtests. 
In the next weeks i will focus on the levels and lightning of each room, expect a new update on that.
Yet i can't announce a release date, but if everything goes fine the game will be ready before the end of the year, but for the best launch possible i'm taking into consideration a collaboration with a publisher for a proper marketing campaign. 
Finally i was asked if the music in the trailer is up somewhere to download, and to that i answer not yet, it's an original soundtrack and i will probably add it in a bundle with the game when it releases.
Thank you for your support, see you to the next update that will come soon
